_comment: Module definition for the lmsim collector simulator and the source of truth for building the DataSource in a portal. Not LogicMonitor's export format.
name: TLS_Certificate_Expiry-
description: Monitors remaining lifetime of TLS certificates on arbitrary endpoints.

alertMessage.subject: TLS cert on ##INSTANCE## expires in ##VALUE## days (##HOST##)
alertMessage.body:
Datapoint ##DATAPOINT## on ##INSTANCE## is ##VALUE##, crossing threshold ##THRESHOLD##. Renew before expiry.
Resource: ##HOST##   Level: ##LEVEL##

datapoints.name: handshakeOk
datapoints.description: 1 if a TLS handshake completed, 0 if the endpoint was unreachable or refused TLS.

alertMessage.subject: TLS handshake failed on ##INSTANCE## (##HOST##)
alertMessage.body:
Could not complete a TLS handshake with ##INSTANCE## (##DSIDESCRIPTION##). Expiry is not being measured until it recovers.
Resource: ##HOST##   Level: ##LEVEL##

datapoints.name: daysUntilExpiry
datapoints.description: Whole days until the leaf certificate's notAfter; negative once expired.

datapoints.name: daysSinceIssued
datapoints.description: Whole days since the leaf certificate's notBefore.

datapoints.name: chainLength
datapoints.description: Number of certificates the server presented.

datapoints.name: chainTrusted
datapoints.description: 1 if a fully validating handshake (default trust store, hostname check) succeeds, else 0.

alertMessage.subject: TLS cert on ##INSTANCE## is not trusted (##HOST##)
alertMessage.body:
A validating handshake with ##INSTANCE## failed: the chain, expiry or hostname does not check out against the collector's trust store.
Resource: ##HOST##   Level: ##LEVEL##
